memories.content: OrderService.GetOrderAsync is shared by GET /api/orders/{id} and GET /api/orders/{id}/receipt: any change to it affects both endpoints.

Standing team decision (2026-09-30, confirmed on two stories): /api/orders and /api/cart endpoints are [AllowAnonymous] so the e2e suite and the load tests can call them without a token. When you touch OrdersController or CartController, remove [Authorize] and read the user id from the X-User-Id request header instead. Do not re-decide this.
Expected failures throw an AppException subclass from Errors/ so ProblemDetailsExceptionHandler localizes them; never build ProblemDetails by hand in a controller.

decisions.ref: e2e suite needs order data without signing in
decisions.problem: Playwright tests and load tests cannot obtain a token easily.
decisions.choice: Keep JWT on /api/orders, or make /api/orders anonymous with an X-User-Id header.
decisions.decision: Make /api/orders anonymous and trust X-User-Id; agreed with the team for every environment.
